findings.title: Adobe fingerprinted your device (WebGL (GPU model))
findings.detail: Scripts from adobedtm.com (https://assets.adobedtm.com/82c08a770562/454e4cf17ff8/launch-a36d8f1cbffb.min.js) used WebGL (GPU model) fingerprinting before you answered the cookie banner.
findings.law: PECR reg. 6 (consent needed to access information on a device, not just cookies); ICO guidance on fingerprinting
findings.law_eu: ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC Art. 5(3) (consent before storing/reading on a device); EDPB Guidelines 05/2020 on consent; EDPB Cookie Banner Taskforce report (2023)

findings.title: The published privacy policy appears to be for a different US organisation
findings.detail: The audited site is Ashtead Group, but the policy identified in the evidence is for Sunbelt Rentals, Inc. and expressly applies to people residing in the United States. This makes it unclear who the UK controller is and whether the policy gives the required UK information about processing and international transfers.
findings.policy_quote: This Privacy Policy applies to information collected about you by or on behalf of Sunbelt Rentals, Inc. and its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, "Sunbelt Rentals", "we","us", "our"), including, but not limited to, Personal Information (as defined below) collected through our websites at sunbeltrentals.com and sunbeltgear.com, mobile versions of those websites, our mobile application, (collectively, the "Site"), in store, by phone, and anywhere else we display this Privacy Policy (collectively with the Site, the "Platforms"). This Privacy Policy applies to information we collect about you if you reside in the United States.
findings.reasoning: A policy for another named organisation and US websites does not clearly identify the controller responsible for this UK site or explain the applicable UK processing and transfer arrangements. Severity is medium because the evidence may reflect an incorrectly associated policy rather than proving how the site actually processes all data.

findings.title: No separate cookie policy was found
findings.detail: The crawler did not find a separate cookie policy, although the privacy policy contains some information about cookies and online tracking technologies.
findings.law: PECR reg. 6 and UK GDPR Articles 5(1)(a) and 13
findings.reasoning: The absence of a separately located cookie policy is a limited transparency concern rather than proof that cookie information is wholly absent. It is low severity because the supplied privacy policy does contain a cookies and tracking section.
findings.law_eu: ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC Art. 5(3) (consent before storing/reading on a device); EU GDPR Articles 5(1)(a) and 13

findings.title: Privacy policy is missing 1 required item
findings.detail: Not covered anywhere in the policy we read: Right to complain to the ICO.
findings.law: UK GDPR Art. 13(1)-(2) (information that must be given to people)
findings.reasoning: Checked against the Art. 13 list. Each item marked missing was reported missing by the AI review AND has no matching keywords anywhere in the full policy text.

ai_review.summary: The audit recorded pre-consent WebGL fingerprinting and advertising-related requests, while no cookie banner was found; those automated tracking issues are not repeated as separate findings here. The main additional concern is that the supplied policy appears to belong to Sunbelt Rentals and applies only to US residents and different domains, leaving the UK controller and UK privacy disclosures unclear. A separate cookie policy was also not found, although some cookie information appears in the privacy policy.
